recipes.title: The Best Juicy Skillet Pork Chops

ingredients.name: bone-in or boneless pork chops (about 1 inch thick, 6 to 7 oz each)
avocado oil (or high smoke-point cooking oil)

steps: Take pork chops out of the refrigerator and let rest at room temperature for 30 minutes.
In a small bowl, combine salt, black pepper, chili powder, garlic powder, onion powder, and smoked paprika. Rub the spice blend evenly over all sides of the chops.
Dust both sides of each pork chop lightly with all-purpose flour, tapping off any excess.
Heat avocado oil in a large skillet (cast iron or stainless steel) over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Add the pork chops to the skillet and sear undisturbed for 3 to 4 minutes until a deep golden-brown crust forms.
Flip the chops and cook the other side for an additional 3 to 4 minutes, or until an instant-read meat thermometer inserted into the thickest part reads 135°F for medium.
Transfer pork chops to a warm plate and tent loosely with foil to rest for 5 minutes (internal temperature will carry over to 145°F).

Pour off any excess grease from the skillet, leaving about 1 tablespoon. Lower heat to medium, then pour in the chicken stock, apple cider vinegar, and honey, scraping up browned bits from the pan bottom.
Simmer the sauce until reduced by half, about 3 to 5 minutes.
Remove skillet from heat, swirl in unsalted butter until melted and glossy, and stir in chopped parsley.
Drizzle the pan sauce over the rested pork chops and serve.
recipes.swaps: Can use boneless or bone-in thick chops; vegetable or canola oil can replace avocado oil.
recipes.notes: Equipment: Large skillet (cast iron or heavy stainless steel), tongs, instant-read thermometer. Resting for 30 minutes before cooking ensures even browning.

recipes.title: Best Damn Pan Seared Pork Chops

ingredients.name: bone-in pork chops (at least 1 inch thick)
avocado oil (or high smoke-point cooking oil)

steps: Pat the pork chops completely dry with paper towels on both sides.
Season generously with kosher salt and freshly cracked black pepper all over.
Heat avocado oil in a cast iron skillet over medium-high heat until smoking lightly.
Carefully place pork chops in the skillet and sear for 4 to 5 minutes without moving until a golden-brown sear develops.
Flip the chops and cook for 3 minutes on the second side.
Turn heat to medium-low, add unsalted butter, crushed garlic cloves, thyme sprigs, and rosemary sprigs to the skillet.
Tilt the pan slightly and continuously spoon the foaming melted butter over the pork chops for 2 to 3 minutes until internal temperature reaches 140°F.
Remove chops from skillet and place on a cutting board or plate to rest for 5 minutes before serving (resting brings temperature to FDA-recommended 145°F).
recipes.swaps: Can use olive oil if heat is carefully managed; dried herbs can be used in a pinch (1/2 tsp each).
recipes.notes: Equipment: Cast iron skillet, metal spoon for basting, instant-read thermometer. Continuous butter basting infuses aromatics and keeps the meat tender.
